artifact_disposition.footprint_summary: New task artifacts occupy 4.27 GB after retirement; observed peak was 14.47 GB. Conservative compute accounting, including CPU admission, totals 6168.3 seconds (102.8 minutes).
artifact_disposition.pilot_summary: Retired 2 closed, unselected probe states through Store retention after compact extraction, preserving the original final state and native probe exports. Exact probe optimizer/RNG resume is unavailable; the original parent and recipe remain sufficient to repeat qualification.

retained.reusable_evidence: all three-arm and routine panels, authenticated shared references, original control dependencies

retained.validation_history: initial derived CPU reports retained, superseded by v2

artifact_disposition.shared_changes: No shared model, bank, reference or historical state deleted. Existing canonical records and campaign screen unchanged.

access.disjointness: new source families, ancestry identities, exact canonical messages and token paths checked against the 6K TRAIN bank, existing DEV bank, both TRAIN expansion banks and opaque protected identities; no claim about target pretraining exposure

ancestry_audit.scope: additional old-corpus and legacy TRAIN audit; no sealed/heldout files were opened; exact matches checked, semantic paraphrase overlap and target pretraining are not established

protection.reason: The first union also included old TRAIN identities used for disjointness checks; v2 protects only existing heldout identities and new confirmation data, leaving existing TRAIN admission unchanged. Neither file has been used to run inference or training.
